answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 45336 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Beer and Interest Question: (1)I am writing you form Abu Dhabi. We are confused as somebody is saying that Beer is not haram and it does not contain alcohol. Also there are two types of beer available in the market halal and other. What is the correct? (2) Abu Dhabi Mufti has given Fatwa that interest is not haram but take to other caste as a Hindu and Christian etc. But I am not satisfied, we had too much shooting with mufti. What is the correct answer? Answer ID: 45336 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 825/802/N=1434) (1) Beer is a kind of wine. However, it contains less alcohol in contrary to wine; hence those who are addicted to intoxication it puts less effect on them. However, it is wine hence it is not lawful to drink it in any case. (2) As it is not lawful for Muslims to take interest from Muslims in the same way it is also not lawful to take it from non-Muslims, the reason is that the evidences of unlawfulness of interest are common. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
